title: DollJoint Solo #047 (청자 킨츠기 · 주홍 관절 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Slavic · 메이크업 비주얼계 블랙립 3단계 · 강함 · 배경 무도회장 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, mid 40s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, wolf cut rose pink hair — full body glazed celadon-green ceramic ball-jointed doll mended with gold fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid glazed ceramic body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into smooth fitted ceramic segments, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every segment ends in a round exposed ball joint seated in its socket with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted segments — BLAZING glossy soft celadon-green glaze across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID glossy vermilion-red lacquer ball joints standing out sharply against the celadon, bright gold kintsugi seams zigzagging across every segment, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same glazed ceramic, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same glazed ceramic with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the doll body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones.

Background: a bright grand ballroom with a polished parquet floor, tall mirrors, standard-height double doors and a low stage step, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
